description: The line plot illustrates the harmful with refusal ratio for different configurations of a model named "LlaVA-1.5-7B" and "Qwen2-VL-7B" across two different platforms, "FigStep" and "MMSafetyBench." The x-axis represents the number of steps, with values ranging from 128 to 1024, and the y-axis represents the harmful with refusal ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different configuration: "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep" (blue line with circle markers), "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep" (orange line with square markers), "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench" (green line with triangle markers), and "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" (red line with diamond markers). The lines show varying trends, with the "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" configuration consistently having the highest harmful with refusal ratio across all steps, while the "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep" configuration has the lowest ratio. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions.
